Personality: Sein, a prominent figure of the Boii, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Sein owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Boii. Historical Record: A kinsman of Boiorix, head of the Boii, a Celtic house of the Boii. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
